ci.name: Six Drop v248 connected groups colors and HUD

assertions: Connected same-color components of four or more clear, including non-geometric forms.
Geometric roles retain whole-color clearing; duplicate cells accrue once.
Refill has no pre-existing connected four or geometric role; stable survivors keep color and number.
A pocket surrounded by four distinct color triples cannot freeze refill or produce an immediate clear.
The game-start palette is fixed through all hits and refills; the next game advances at each 100 cleared drops, capped at orange/red/pink/violet.
Each removed drop adds current game BET times 0.05 without repricing prior balance.
All-clear collects the balance without consuming it; own-game zero WIN resets it; inactive Six Drop does not reset.
Existing balances preserved, including fractional units.
Independent-player carry, exactly-once settlement, forced-cancel rollback and own-zero reset verified.
Palette/checkpoint restored in the payout worker and after cold restart.
Newer public WebSocket state cannot discard an exact current own-token reservation ACK or trigger a duplicate forced BET request.
server.monitorRule: Maximum confirmed tier across participating games: >=3 times that game's BET red, >=10 times purple, explicit newly achieved highest role rainbow. Monetary 50x alone is not a highest role. Displayed amounts, ratios and bar heights retain combined-game totals.

browser.engine: Chromium in GitHub Actions, actual application plus local HTTP/WebSocket server

payoutSampling.scope: Direct Six Drop payouts with carry across positive games; shared Sugar/JPC excluded. Finite stochastic samples do not guarantee an exact payout rate.
payoutSampling.timing: Full calibration samples preceded the rare impossible-pocket fallback fix, which was not exercised in those samples. The successful refill path and rates are unchanged. Final regression tests exercise the fallback.

limitations: No physical Windows host or iPhone device was available. PowerShell syntax and Windows encoding guards passed in CI.
The server on the user's Windows PC requires installing this source update and restarting. Existing client/monitor pages need reload.
CI screenshot artifact has a seven-day retention period; this JSON and the reproducible tests remain in source control.
